psychological_meaning: Smalt Blue evokes feelings of calmness, stability, and sophistication. It blends the tranquility of blue with a hint of complexity, suggesting trustworthiness and reliability. It is often associated with professionalism and understated elegance, lending a sense of competence and peace. This color can also inspire introspection and a sense of inner peace.
